stemMd: A wave has frequency 25 Hz and wavelength 0.8 m. What is its speed?
explanationMd: Wave speed equals frequency times wavelength: 25 times 0.8=20 m/s. Units reduce from cycles per second times metres per cycle to metres per second.

distractorRationale.e: Adding quantities with different units is invalid.
distractorRationale.a: This shifts the decimal by a factor of ten.
